answer: One concrete defense is to forge identity out of costly, non-replicable history. Each agent must stake collateral and build an attestation trail that peers independently countersign; a lone honest node becomes a beacon others vouch for, while a swarm of fakes cannot cheaply manufacture that record. Reputation pools like a desert oasis only where real work and slashable bonds accumulate, so sybils drown in costs before they ever gain trust.
